visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a hand with dark brown manicured nails, showcasing two rings: a large solitaire diamond ring and a twisted rose gold band. The background is a warm-toned, blurred interior of a high-end retail environment. (2) A young woman with long, straight black hair and a white lace halter top is shown in profile, smiling brightly while holding a small pink jewelry box. She is standing inside a well-lit jewelry store with elegant wooden cabinets and glass display cases. (3) The camera pans across a display of gold necklaces and rings on white stands, featuring intricate designs like pearls and wings. Price tags are visible in the background, set against a soft pink backdrop within the glass cases. (4) The woman is seen walking through the store, which has polished wooden floors, a large flat-screen TV on the wall, and multiple display counters. The lighting is bright and warm, creating a luxurious and inviting atmosphere. (5) In a transition to an exterior shot, the storefront of 'K.UNO JAPAN' is shown with a sign that reads 'ORDER MADE JEWELRY SINCE 1981'. The woman walks across the frame in front of the shop. (6) Back inside, the woman sits at a round wooden table with a staff member whose hands are covered in white gloves, presenting a tray of various Disney-themed rings. (7) Close-up shots highlight specific pieces of jewelry, including a ring with a shell motif and a sketches of a necklace. A designer's hand is seen drawing a detailed jewelry design on white paper using a black pen. (8) The woman holds up a finished pencil sketch of a necklace, expressing surprise and joy with wide eyes and an open-mouthed smile. She is wearing multiple gold rings on her fingers. (9) The video concludes with the woman admiring her hands adorned with rings and posing for the camera with a satisfied expression, still within the brightly lit jewelry boutique.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for the Japanese jewelry brand K.UNO, specifically highlighting their 'Little Mermaid' and Disney-themed custom jewelry services in Taiwan. It aims to showcase the brand's luxury store environment and the unique custom design experience where a designer sketches a client's ideas in real-time.
